senses.definition: A feeling of depression resulting from being alone or from having no companions.
senses.example: The loneliness resulting from the loss of loved ones, lack of purpose in life, and social discrimination is a real inner hell.

senses.definition: The condition or state of being alone or having no companions.
senses.example: Hitherto all things that have bin nam’d, were approv’d of God to be very good: lonelines is the first thing which Gods eye nam’d not good […]

senses.definition: The state of being unfrequented or devoid of human activity (of a place or time).
senses.example:
1794, Ann Radcliffe, The Mysteries of Udolpho, London: G.G. & J. Robinson, Volume 4, Chapter 3, p. 50,
[…] as she sat at her bed-side, indulging melancholy reveries, which the loneliness of the hour assisted […]

senses.definition: A desire to be alone; disposition to solitude.
senses.example:

The mystery of your loneliness, and find
Your salt tears’ head: now to all sense ’tis gross
You love my son […]
